caption: The drawing depicts a single large, cylindrical pottery jar with a wide mouth and two handles positioned symmetrically on opposite sides near the upper rim. The main body of the jar is colored in shades of cool gray, and it has a smooth, slightly curved surface. Around the upper portion of the jar, just below the rim and between the handles, there is a decorative horizontal band featuring a blue motif of elongated leaves or branches, interspersed with clusters resembling berries or grapes, all rendered in rich shades of blue and purple. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color with some visible light brown stains or marks, and there are faint pencil marks outlining the jar. The shading on the jar gives it a three-dimensional appearance, and the decoration stands out due to the contrasting vivid blue colors against the neutral gray of the jar.
title: Pickle Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
